title: Privacy & browser storage
intro: This is Leo Deng’s personal website. This notice covers leodeng.dev and its classic edition at old.leodeng.dev.

sections.title: Your preferences
paragraphs: Your browser can remember your theme, language, and the interests you select on the Interests page using local storage. These settings stay in that browser until you clear them.

Choosing the full site on an older device sets a site_view cookie for 30 days so you are not redirected back to the classic site. The classic site also uses session storage to remember why you were redirected during that tab’s session.

sections.title: Hosting & connection information
paragraphs: Cloudflare delivers and protects this site and its media. It processes connection information such as IP addresses and request headers, and may use security cookies depending on the protection features in use. The IP & connection page displays information about your own request.
Cloudflare handles information under its own policies. I do not set a separate retention period for Cloudflare’s operational records.

sections.title: The optional Apple Music player
paragraphs: The About page leaves Apple’s player unloaded until you choose “Load Apple Music player.” Loading it allows Apple to receive connection and player-usage information and use cookies or similar local storage. Apple describes collection even when you are not signed in.

The choice is not saved between visits. You can unload the player on the page; that does not erase data Apple has already stored. You can also open the playlist directly on Apple Music. The classic edition provides links instead of embedding the player.

sections.title: Other external services
paragraphs: Depending on the page, your browser may request Google Fonts, public data from GitHub, lyrics from LRCLIB, or cover art from external providers such as Cover Art Archive. Those providers receive connection information when your browser contacts them. Links to other websites take you to services with their own privacy practices.
The site’s own browser storage supports the features described above. I have not added advertising trackers to the site’s application code.

sections.title: Daily AI and abuse controls
paragraphs: Daily AI offers five fixed questions, answered live by a local model on my homelab. Visitors cannot submit text. Only the fixed question ID, a random job ID and the day reach the homelab relay; IP addresses and user agents do not. The model receives a fixed prompt and public site content. Its thinking output and answer are streamed as generated and may be inaccurate.

The AI endpoint stores your IP address and chosen question to enforce one selection per Beijing calendar day. Selection records are pruned after seven days when a new question is accepted. Generated answers and model thinking are retained on Cloudflare for about seven days so the same answer can be reopened; cleanup runs daily. Failed or cancelled generations can be retried. The admin can reset allowances and bans for testing. Malformed AI requests and curl/Python user agents create permanent AI-endpoint bans. A ban stores the IP address, a short reason and a timestamp until I remove it through the admin page. These bans do not block the rest of the website.

sections.title: Your choices & contact
paragraphs: You can leave the Apple Music player unloaded and read the site normally. Browser settings let you inspect, block, or clear cookies and local storage. Clearing saved preferences resets them.
For questions about this site’s privacy practices, email me.
